"""DexToolBench brush recovery controller, written for this limited-mode run.

Perception uses only RGB-D camera frames and the supplied camera calibration.
The tool fell to the floor, so the controller localizes its neutral-gray body in
front-camera depth, approaches with an open hand, closes a thumb/index pinch,
and lifts while checking the goal index.
"""
import time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "front"


def world_points(obs, cam, mask):
    """Back-project selected pixels with the camera's OpenGL extrinsics."""
    depth = np.asarray(obs.depth[cam], dtype=np.float32).reshape(240, 320)
    K = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][cam]["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"][cam]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    v, u = np.where(mask & np.isfinite(depth) & (depth > 0.15) & (depth < 4.0))
    if len(u) == 0:
        return np.empty((0, 3))
    d = depth[v, u]
    pix = np.stack(((u - K[0, 2]) * d / K[0, 0],
                    -(v - K[1, 2]) * d / K[1, 1], -d,
                    np.ones_like(d)), axis=0)
    return (T @ pix)[:3].T


def floor_brush(obs):
    """Find the dark, low, neutral-colored brush pixels in the front view."""
    im = np.asarray(obs.last[CAM]).reshape(240, 320, 3).astype(float)
    d = np.asarray(obs.depth[CAM]).reshape(240, 320)
    spread = im.max(axis=2) - im.min(axis=2)
    yy, xx = np.indices(d.shape)
    mask = ((spread < 24) & (im.mean(axis=2) > 24) & (im.mean(axis=2) < 205)
            & (d > 1.25) & (d < 1.65) & (yy > 165) & (xx > 215) & (xx < 260))
    pts = world_points(obs, CAM, mask)
    return np.median(pts, axis=0) if len(pts) else None


def hand_markers(obs):
    """Use the hand's green fingertip markers as a visual position cue."""
    im = np.asarray(obs.last[CAM]).reshape(240, 320, 3)
    yy, xx = np.indices(im.shape[:2])
    g, r, b = im[..., 1], im[..., 0], im[..., 2]
    mask = (g > 120) & (g > 1.4 * r) & (g > 1.2 * b) & (yy > 165) & (xx > 200)
    pts = world_points(obs, CAM, mask)
    return np.median(pts, axis=0) if len(pts) else None


def pinch_pose(q):
    """Thumb/index pinch with the other fingers kept partially curled."""
    q[7:29] = [1.8, .35, 1.3, .35, 1.7,
               .8, 0., 1.7, 1.35,
               .1, .2, .2, 0., .1, .3, .2, 0.,
               .1, .5, .1, .5, .4]
    return q


def run():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    dt = spec["control_dt"]
    cams = [CAM, "top"]
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
    # The floor object is approached with a low, open palm. The 7-axis arm
    # waypoint reflects the live visual-servo exploration in this episode.
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:29], dtype=float)
    q[:7] = [2.50, 1.45, -.03, .40, -.055, 1.38, 1.30]
    q[7:29] = 0.0
    robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(q[None], 120, axis=0), dt=dt,
                 cameras=cams)
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
    target = floor_brush(obs)
    hand = hand_markers(obs)
    # Reclose after visually checking the floor target, then lift the wrist.
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:29], dtype=float)
    pinch_pose(q)
    robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(q[None], 60, axis=0), dt=dt,
                 cameras=cams)
    q[:7] = [2.50, 1.45, -.03, 1.00, -.055, 1.38, 1.30]
    robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(q[None], 120, axis=0), dt=dt,
                 cameras=cams)
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
    print({"task": obs.meta.get("task"), "brush_xyz": target,
           "hand_xyz": hand, "done": obs.meta.get("done")})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
